hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part, then
  Part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  Part cancels its cast.
  If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is "2", then part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "02", buddyId: the character RAMZA}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
